images.title: One stick for every cow
images.purpose: Shows one-to-one mapping: each returning cow is paired with one stick, and the 2 sticks left over are the 2 missing cows.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A row of cows across the upper half and a row of sticks across the lower half, joined by thin lines, with the two unpaired sticks highlighted at the right end.
images.exact_structure: Top row: exactly 5 simple flat cow silhouettes (white fill, dark outline), evenly spaced from the left. Bottom row: exactly 7 upright dark (#2B2B2B) sticks of equal length, evenly spaced, the first 5 directly under the 5 cows. Exactly 5 thin grey (#6B7280) straight lines, each joining one cow to the stick under it. Sticks 6 and 7 at the right have no line and are ringed together by one vermilion (#D55E00) rounded outline with the label 2 missing under it. Between the rows on the left, small teal (#0072B2) text: one cow, one stick. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Pair each object with exactly one stick; unpaired sticks show what is missing.
images.description: Shows one-to-one mapping: each returning cow is paired with one stick, and the 2 sticks left over are the 2 missing cows.
images.context: Worked example: 2 sticks left in the evening means 2 cows are missing.

image_decisions.why: The pairing lines make one-to-one mapping visible without any number names.
